5241901.text: Please take note that the announcement concerning the marriage between Sir Kujou Kamaji and Lady Hiiragi Chisato has been found to have been released in error due to a miscommunication within the Kanjou Commission.

5241902.text: We sincerely apologize for any subsequent confusion or misunderstandings.

5241903.text: The staff involved have been severely reprimanded, and the Shogunate pledges to enhance communication discipline and eliminate any such incidents in the future.

5241904.text: Let it be known that the matrimonial ceremonies have been delayed, and that further details will become available at a later date.

5170101.text: This Ritou bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all kinds of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

5170201.text: Former Kanjou Commissioner Hiiragi Shinsuke now awaits the Almighty Shogun's judgment regarding his crimes of high treason. Owing to his age and in acknowledgment of his past contributions, he is presently indefinitely detained without bail.

5170202.text: However, should he commit any more acts of treason during this detention, he will be branded a public enemy of the Inazuman state and his judgment shall be enacted with extreme prejudice and without any mercy.

5170203.text: While the Kanjou Commission debates the matter of his successor, the Commission's duties shall be performed by a personal deputy of Her Excellency.

5170204.text: The duties of Kanjou Commission staff will not be adjusted. We urge all staff to remain calm and follow any arrangements sent from your superiors.

5170301.text: As we are presently in a state of ceasefire and peace, imports to Watatsumi Island will resume.

5170302.text: Once the matter of trade route security is agreed upon by both the Shogunate and Sangonomiya, the commercial port to Watatsumi Island will be opened shortly.

5170401.text: With Lady Miko's permission, the Grand Shrine will soon host a large-scale event.

5170402.text: This is a rare opportunity, so we encourage all shrine maidens, clergy, and commission staff to make preparations soon!

5170403.text: Lady Miko, Lord Commissioner, we beseech you both to please exercise some control over Naganohara Fireworks!

5170404.text: We of the Fire Brigade are always stretched to breaking point every time Yoimiya takes part in a festival...

5170405.text: Please, we implore you, take pity on us!

5170406.text: We would like to express our deepest apologies as well. We will be sure to keep Yoimiya in check in the future.

5170501.text: Yashiori Island's Jakotsu Mine has been closed temporarily, with representatives from the Shogunate and Sangonomiya discussing future development. It will be reopened soon after an agreement has been reached.

5170502.text: Former miners from Jakotsu may claim job loss compensation from the Yashiro Commission estates and may also take the occasion to indicate preferred avenues of future employment.

5170601.text: The special privileges granted to Snezhnayan merchants in trade and in port affairs have been revoked. Any accumulated arrears must be paid within 2 weeks, or Ritou will not extend further protection to your goods and cargo.

5170602.text: We ask all shipments of military equipment and material to leave the borders of Inazuma and Sangonomiya immediately. The Fatui and all related personnel are included in this order.

5170603.text: "You should've done this a long time ago! We barely had any breathing room with all these Snezhnayan merchants eating up all the privileges and getting special treatment!"

5170604.text: "Especially those Fatui loansharks! Now they'll get what's coming to them, hah!"

5170701.text: I'm searching for my husband, Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. He is a tall man without any facial hair and has a scar on the side of his forehead. He has yet to return home despite the ceasefire.

5170702.text: If any returning samurai or old friends and acquaintances know of his whereabouts, please inform me. You will be duly thanked for your help!

5170801.text: Their Excellencies, the Almighty Ogosho and Watatsumi's Divine Priestess, both express their deep grief at the many tragedies that occurred at Tatarasuna and on Yashiori Island.

5170802.text: From this day forth, the Shogunate and Sangonomiya will begin reconstruction and redevelopment work in these lands in partnership with one another.

5170803.text: Together, we will pacify this war-torn land, bring the guilty to justice, and restore Inazuma's prosperity.

5170804.text: All the more must we follow the divine wisdom of Her Excellency the Shogun, acting as one to accomplish the great cause of Eternity.

5170901.text: "Outlander merchants, if you are facing any issues or difficulties in Ritou,"

5170902.text: "Come find Mr. Kurisu at the International Trade Association. We will do our best to help you!"

5170903.text: "If there is anything that you don't understand or that troubles you, come look for us."

5170904.text: "The International Trade Association's doors are always open to outlanders from any nation."

5171001.text: The Outlander Affairs Agency is presently doing away with past unfair taxes and duties to lessen the burden on merchants in Ritou.

5171002.text: We will seek deeper cooperation with the International Trade Association going forward in order to better serve local and outlander merchants alike.

5171003.text: Additionally, emigres from other regions seeking work here can submit documentation indicating their employment preferences at the Kamisato Clan estates.

5171101.text: "Kujou Tengu! Didn't we agree to have a sumo duel? Where've you run off to!?"

5171102.text: "Bet you lost a fight and can't show your face outside anymore, eh? Hope you're not crying in some corner with your bald wings wrapped around yourself or anything!"

5171103.text: "Come on, don't worry about it! You win some and you lose some, am I right?"

5171104.text: "Seriously though, I've got no time for your moping. We've got a duel to settle!"

5171105.text: Madam Kujou has never been defeated in battle and remains triumphant today. Please do not slander her, you knave!

5171201.text: "I haven't seen Ritou quite as busy as it has been recently with all these guests from Sangonomiya coming ashore."

5171202.text: "Well, that said, it was their protests toward the Shogun that got those corrupt Commissions knocked down a peg or ten..."

5171203.text: "It's thanks to them that we outlanders can now look forward to better days."

5171302.text: "Many matters await me in my homeland, so please forgive my abrupt and early departure."

5171303.text: "I have heard that Yashiori Island has been handed over to the management of Sangonomiya and that the once-bustling mines will no longer open..."

5171304.text: "It pleases me little to see my hometown change hands... But at least now I have hope to return at all."

5171305.text: "I hope that the Shogunate will take this as a lesson. Such a great 'loss' must never happen again..."

5171401.text: "The Artificial Onikabuto Tournament is taking in applicants now!"

5171402.text: Tough youngsters, hale old folks, depressed uncles, and alcoholic aunties! Everyone is free to participate!

5171403.text: "Experience endless proxy battles here! The upcoming match is:"

5171404.text: "Village Shophouse Sharptongue versus Baron Vishap Tamagoyaki! Battling it out in a high-stakes, winner-take-all, no-holds-barred brawl!"

5171405.text: "The trends nowadays among youngsters are... getting harder and harder to wrap one's head around."

5171501.text: "We can expect the various commercial routes between us and the other nations to open up one after the other. Better days are coming soon, indeed."

5171502.text: "Many thanks to our friends and competitors here in Ritou for helping us to make it this far."

5171503.text: "You're too kind. I think everyone believes that we'll make it as long as there's business to be done."

5171504.text: "Haha, that's right! But don't get too chummy or lose your edge now — don't forget that we're rivals out there in the mercantile world!"

5171601.text: The Yae Publishing House's reader's forum will proceed as planned. Our outlander readers from Ritou are also welcome to make the trip here to the Publishing House!

5171602.text: Lady Yae Miko welcomes the attendance of passionate readers everywhere!

5171701.text: "Fresh Dandelion Wine from Mondstadt! Osmanthus Tea from Liyue! High-grade Cor Lapis!"

5171702.text: "Don't ask how it got here — but ask us anything about the quality!"

5171703.text: Citizens, please take note! Do not in any wise be taken in by the lying words of smugglers!

5171801.text: "There's been a youngster in Tenryou Commission garb going about recently. Is this some result of the Almighty Shogun's latest decrees?"

5171802.text: "I mean, seeing Commission members go about official business in public is not uncommon, exactly, but this kid just looks way too young."

5171803.text: "I mean, I swear this kid looks younger than Lord Commissioner Ayato. I just can't convince myself that this is official business, you know?"
